items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Makes First Net Stock Move In 14 Quarters
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.A) has expanded its Alphabet stake, making the stock its third-largest U.S.-listed equity holding. The move represents Berkshire's first quarter of net stock buying in 14 quarters under new CEO Greg Abel. Recent portfolio activity also includes fresh transactions in Delta Air Lines and homebuilder Taylor Morrison. items.title: Here Are Big Tech’s Big SpaceX Investors
items.summary: SpaceX shares got a lift after some of tech’s top names identified themselves as big investors in Elon Musk's rocket-and-AI company. Among them: artificial-intelligence chipmaker Nvidia, which said in a Friday filing it owned close to 123 million SpaceX shares.
